messages.subject: Project Willow - advice note on the Bank's rights (PRIVILEGED)
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Please find attached our advice note on the Company's position under the Existing Facilities Agreement and the recommended standstill strategy. In short: the Q4 breaches are Events of Default, but acceleration would be value-destructive for the Bank, so a consensual route is realistic.

Key near-term actions: agree standstill heads of terms (targeting 20 Feb), engage Marlow on the IBR, and begin shareholder discussions on the £4.0m injection.

Please treat as privileged.

James Osei
Senior Associate, Restructuring & Finance
Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
